svg.title: Sound keys of HL Semaron, HL Pirzath, HL Thuravark, HL Qalezu, HL Veldikko, HL Vedyakshara and HL Helónika
svg.text: Each key types the same sound in HL Semaron, HL Pirzath, HL Thuravark, HL Qalezu, HL Veldikko, HL Vedyakshara and HL Helónika, in that script's own letters.
bottom left: the key · top left: with Shift
bottom right: with Option (AltGr; \ then the key in Emacs) · top right: with Option+Shift
markup: the key types itself, as plain ASCII, in every layout
sign: only the layout of its script types it (HL Veldikko, HL Helónika)
